Callout.Name: Stolen Property - Recovery
Callout.Message: High-value property believed held in a garage.

Script.Line: The garage has been locked since we moved in.
I have never been in the garage. The landlord keeps the key.
You can break it down. It is not my door.

Lines.Approach: The property went missing three weeks ago and it is in that garage. The rest is paperwork.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
